Data Analyst salary in the United States

Based on 428 current job listings that show pay on Fortune Jobs AI (updated November 24, 2026), listed pay for Data Analyst jobs in the United States is $71,284–$120,493 a year (middle 50% of listed salary midpoints). The median listed midpoint is about $100,000 a year. These figures describe listed pay in current postings, not a salary survey. Hourly and yearly figures are not mixed or extrapolated.

Frequently asked questions

What is typical listed pay?

The median listed salary midpoint is about $100,000 a year across 428 current postings. The middle 50% is $71,284–$120,493 a year.

Which employers list the highest pay?

Current: about $163,750 a year (median of 2 listings); Bright Vision Technologies: about $140,000 a year (median of 2 listings); Everest Group: about $137,500 a year (median of 2 listings); Nordstrom: about $136,500 a year (median of 2 listings); Pfizer: about $135,900 a year (median of 2 listings). Only employers with at least two usable listings of the same pay unit are compared.

How does remote pay compare with on-site pay?

The listed midpoint median is about $87,438 a year for 12 remote listings and about $116,650 a year for 13 explicitly on-site listings. These are different postings, not controlled estimates of a remote-work premium.

What pay is listed for entry-level and new-grad jobs?

The median listed midpoint is about $73,760 a year from 17 entry-level and new-grad postings with usable pay. Internship listings are excluded from this comparison.
